title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 42
description: Ten questions on Psalms 42: a soul thirsting for God like a deer for water, and the call to hope in God.

questions.text: In verse 1, the psalmist's soul pants after God as the deer pants for what?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says, "As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God."

questions.text: Verse 2 says, "My soul thirsts for God, for the..." what God?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "My soul thirsts for God, for the living God."

questions.text: What have the psalmist's tears been day and night?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says, "My tears have been my food day and night."

questions.text: What do they continually ask the psalmist in verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they continually ask him, "Where is your God?"

questions.text: In verse 4, where does the psalmist remember leading the crowd?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says he remembers how he used to go with the crowd and led them to God's house.

questions.text: Which hill is named in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 mentions the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, and the hill Mizar.

questions.text: What calls to deep at the noise of God's waterfalls in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says, "Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls."

questions.text: What shall be with the psalmist in the night, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says, "In the night his song shall be with me."

questions.text: What does the psalmist call God when he asks, "Why have you forgotten me?"
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says, "I will ask God, my rock, 'Why have you forgotten me?'"

questions.text: How does the adversaries' reproach feel to the psalmist in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says, "As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me."

answers.text: As with a fire in his house
As with a stone on his chest
As with a thorn in his foot
As with a sword in his bones
